description: getDomainAuditTrail: Get the audit trail (history of all changes) for a specific domain. Requires authentication.

domain.description: Fully qualified domain name to fetch the audit trail for (e.g. 'example.com').

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: getDomainAuditTrail
